scope: Pi Agent Policy texture visibility pilot on hexly.ai; approved identity, existing Hero images, source adoption and all other projects remain unchanged.

description.en: Paired contact stops and a single returning trace, drawn clearly on warm mineral paper. The open circuit and short reset path echo bounded recovery. View the full repeat in both themes; use a softer layer beneath text.
description.zh: 暖矿物纸底上的成对触点与一次返回轨迹，呼应有限的恢复机会。加粗线条让断口与返回方向清晰可辨；明暗样张展示完整重复单元，文字下方的底纹适当减淡。
